text: When overriding a nixpkgs package, verify the override argument names against the locked package source before applying the compatibility pin.
Avoid hardcoding application state under ~/.app when the application follows XDG paths; derive the path from config.xdg.dataHome and keep an explicit legacy fallback.

reason: --reason The configuration now intentionally uses only the modern XDG Inshellisense resource path; legacy compatibility is no longer required.

text: Avoid routing a nested Wayland session through a host-scoped launcher daemon; use a separate per-session runtime endpoint so its UI connects to the nested compositor.
When constructing a NixOS session PATH manually, put /run/wrappers/bin before user and system profile bins so privileged wrappers resolve first.
Avoid unused Nix module arguments and derivation lambda parameters; remove them or use the finalAttrs pattern only when attributes actually refer to it
Avoid hardcoding ephemeral third-party model IDs in E2E tests; compare against the live enabled catalog and keep capability mapping cases in deterministic unit tests
Never commit the root result symlink from nix build; ignore /result and use --no-link for validation builds
Avoid adding the same shared CLI package from multiple composed Home Manager modules; give it one profile owner in commandLine and use absolute package paths for module-internal scripts
